# TERA Fishing Guide

Fishing is a relaxing way to earn supplementary gold and gather fish fillets for cooking — and it can be done fully AFK once you get the hang of it.

---

## Getting Started

### Who Can Fish?

Fishing becomes available as soon as you leave **Stepstone Island**. However, the full guided experience unlocks at **level 65**, when the quest **"Let's Go Fishing!"** becomes available. This quest walks you through every aspect of fishing from start to finish, and rewards you with your first rod and bait along the way. It covers:

- Catching fish
- Selling fish
- Buying recipes
- Cooking fish dishes
- Crafting fish crates
- Upgrading your rod and bait

If you want to fish before level 65, you'll need to purchase your own **rod and bait** from a Fishing Supplies merchant at any fishing location.

---

## Finding Fishing Locations

Fishing areas are marked on the world map with a **fish icon**. There are several permanent fisheries spread across the world:

| Fishery                  | Region                 |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------- |
| Muricai Fishery          | Arcadia                |
| Cutthroat Harbor Fishery | Ostgarath              |
| Lake of Tears Fishery    | Poporia                |
| Vexatus Swamp Fishery    | Ostgarath              |
| Celsian Lake Fishery     | Westonia               |
| Seren's Lake Fishery     | Baldur's Refuge        |
| Highwatch Pond           | Lower Highwatch Bazaar |

Special event fishing locations also appear from time to time.

### Getting There

![Waining — Fishing Association Executive in Highwatch](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Waining**, the Fishing Association Executive located in **Highwatch**, can teleport you to any of the fishing areas. Alternatively, you can purchase **Fishery Teleport Scrolls** directly from Fishing Supplies merchants at each location.

---

## Buying Supplies

![Buto — Fishing Supplies Merchant](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Fishing Supplies merchants** (like Buto, pictured above) can be found at every fishing location. They sell rods, bait, teleport scrolls, and other fishing essentials.

![Angler Token Shop UI](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Merchants also run the **Angler Token Shop**, where you can spend Angler Tokens — earned from catching fish — on upgraded fishing rods (such as the Xermetal Rod, Ash Sapling Rod, and Fairywing Rod), special bait, bait designs, and fish crate designs.

---

## How to Fish

### Step 1 — Activate Your Bait

![Bait activation in shortcut tray](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Head to a fishing location and approach the water. **Right-click your bait** to activate it, or place it in your shortcut tray and use it from there. When bait is active, the item icon will **glow** in your tray.

### Step 2 — Cast Your Line

![Casting power bar UI](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Click your **fishing rod** to cast, or place it in your shortcut tray for more control. **Hold** the cast button to charge up the power bar — the further right the marker travels, the farther your line is thrown. **Release** to cast at your desired distance.

### Step 3 — Wait for a Bite

Once your line is in the water, wait until a fish bites. You'll get a visual and audio cue when something takes the hook.

### Step 4 — Reel It In

![Fish reeling UI — press F to pull in](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

When a fish bites, you have two options:

#### Auto / AFK Fishing

Simply **do nothing**. A countdown timer will appear, and once it expires your character automatically reels in the fish and immediately recasts to the same spot. This continues until you run out of bait or inventory space — perfect for going AFK.

> **Note:** You **cannot** catch BAF (Big-Ass-Fish) while auto fishing.

#### Manual Fishing

Press **`F`** to switch to manual reeling. A bar will appear at the top of the screen showing a fish icon and a blue catch box:

- **Push, hold, or release `F`** to move the blue box left and right.
- Keep the **fish icon inside the blue box** — if the fish escapes the box, it moves toward the left.
- Work the fish icon all the way to the **right side** of the bar to land the catch.

Manual fishing gives you the chance to catch higher-grade fish and BAF.

---

## Improving Your Catch Quality

Fish are caught at different grades, and better grades mean more value. You can improve your catch quality by using:

- **Higher quality bait**
- **A better fishing rod**
- **Fish dishes** (cooked buffs)
- **Angler's Whiskers** (special consumable)

Every catch earns you **Angler Tokens** based on the grade of the fish caught. Spend these tokens at the Angler Token Shop to upgrade your gear further.

---

## Selling Your Catch

Fish and fish crates are sold to different vendors:

| Item        | Sold To                        |
| ----------- | ------------------------------ |
| Fish        | Fishing Supply Merchants       |
| Fish Crates | Federation Supply Coordinators |

Both vendors have a **daily purchase limit** — once they've bought their fill for the day, you'll need to wait for their stock to refresh before selling more.

> **Don't let your fish expire!** Each fish remains fresh for **48 hours** in your inventory before it automatically discards. Make sure to sell your fish or break them down into **fish fillets** (for cooking) before they go bad.
